{{Short description|Chinese-American mathematician}}
{{Western name order|Gu Weiqing}}
'''Weiqing Gu''' is a Chinese-American mathematician who works as the Avery Professor of Mathematics and director of the mathematics clinic at [[Harvey Mudd College]]. Her research concerns [[differential geometry]] and [[Grassmannian|Grassmann manifolds]].<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.math.hmc.edu/people/faculty/|title=Mathematics Faculty at HMC|accessdate=2015-09-04|archive-date=2017-06-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170606213225/https://www.math.hmc.edu/people/faculty/|url-status=dead}}.</ref> She has also worked with Harvey Mudd colleague [[Lisette de Pillis]] on the mathematical modeling of [[cancer]].<ref>{{citation|url=http://www.mat.uniroma3.it/scuola_orientamento/echi_stampa/2007/giugno-luglio07/MedicalNews-22-06-07.pdf|title=New Research Project: Curing Cancer With Mathematics|date=June 22, 2007|journal=Medical News Today|accessdate=2015-09-04}}.</ref>

Gu began teaching mathematics at [[Shanghai Normal University|Shanghai Teachers University]] in 1980, earned a bachelor's degree there in 1984, and continued teaching there until 1987.<ref name="cv">{{citation|url=https://www.math.hmc.edu/~gu/cv.pdf|title=Curriculum vitae (long version)|first=Weiqing|last=Gu|year=2005|accessdate=2015-09-04}}.</ref> She began her graduate studies in mathematics at the [[University of Oklahoma]] in 1988, but moved the following year to the [[University of Pennsylvania]],<ref name="cv"/>
completing her Ph.D. in 1995 under the supervision of Herman R. Gluck, a topologist who had been a student of [[Ralph Fox]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=23101}}.</ref> In 1996, she added a master's degree in [[computer science]], also from the University of Pennsylvania, after which she joined the faculty at Harvey Mudd.<ref name="cv"/>
